snapshot.text: Universal National Health System (ESY) shifting from hospital-centred care toward prevention and primary care. Main challenges: appointment delays, limited access to contracted doctors, private consultation costs, weak quality data. Notable now: digital and AI-enabled reforms, including a Quality-for-All pilot since…

priorities.title: Prolamvano national prevention screening programme
priorities.text: Ministry plans a new phase running from September 2026 to 2030. More than 5.2 million citizens had taken part in its preventive examinations by February 2026.

priorities.title: Primary care restructuring and personal doctors
priorities.text: Government reforms, funded under the National Recovery and Resilience framework, aim to restructure primary care services and establish a personal-doctor system alongside hospital modernisation.

priorities.title: Quality-for-All digital quality platform
priorities.text: Pilot launched in March 2026 across 13 healthcare entities, including seven public hospitals and six health centres, to measure and track quality of care.
